text: Entry Requirements 1) High school qualification or above, with an age between 18 to 35. Applicants who are under 18 years old as of September 1, 2026 must submit a Guardian’s Guarantee Letter (download link below). The guardian must be an adult living in China with a stable source of income. 2) In good physical and mental conditions; with reliable guardian for economic guarantee. Non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passport. 3) Following students should meet the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of the Ministry of Education of the PRC: (1) Students emigrate from Mainland of China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and obtain the foreign nationality; (2) Students, whose parents (either or both) hold Chinese nationality and reside abroad, acquire foreign nationality at the time of birth. 4) Take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) test. When applying to our university, applicants must submit their CSCA test results. 5) If you studied or lived in China before, you should not have any record of violation of laws or disciplines. 6) Admission Requirements and Entrance Examinations Applicants must have Chinese proficiency of New HSK level 5. University Entrance examination include Chinese (oral test), English (oral and written tests). University Entrance examination is to be held on the last Saturday in April. For all the majors above, applicants should take CSCA Chinese and Math tests. For the following majors, applicants should also take CSCA in either Physics or Chemistry (choose one): Educational Technology, Actuarial Science, Data Science and Big Data Technology (Natural Language Processing and Financial Big Data). ★Students are not allowed to apply for their native language major.
